firstPlayerRule: The youngest player goes first, rolling the die and drawing a matching category card.
houseFallback: If the youngest players are the same age, use the picker.
internalEvidence: Fetched the PlayMonster-hosted rules PDF listed on playmonster.com/rules-and-activity-guide/ and extracted its text. PDF page 1: "Play • The youngest player rolls the die and draws a category card from the same color pile that is shown on the die."
uncertainty: No tie-break is stated for players of the same age.
